title: Month 1's orders
headline: Morten stays home and delves floor 1 under the tower; the tower keeps its 100 GP and declares no goal yet.
prose: Floor 1 is a level-1 floor under his own warded hex: XP toward level 4 with no wandering checks and no realm to anger. The Gnomes' Garrison in A5 (a Moderate fight) waits until he has seen what a Strike buys.

bullets.label: The tower's goal
bullets.text: none yet. A *take A5* would be a clock of 5 (the Gnomes are Force 3).

bullets.label: The purse
bullets.text: nothing. Works at B5 cost 300 GP; the tower has 100 GP.

words.text: Orders: to the tower's mountains (B5) · Delve floor 1 under B5 · the purse saves. Floor 1 first: safe XP under the wards, and the 100 GP stays put.
